AMENDMENT NO. I MAY 1994 TO IS 8286 : 1976 SPECIFICATION FOR DALAPON� SODIUM SALT WATER SOLUBLE POWDERS
(Page 5, clause 4.1 ) Substitute the following for the existing: 'When freshly manufactured material in bulk quantity is offered for inspection, representative samples of the material shall be drawn and tested as prescribed in IS 10627 : t 983 within 90 days of its manufacture. When the material is offered for inspection after QO days of its manufacture, samp ling shall be done as prescribed in IS 10627 : 1983. However.. the criteria for confonnity of the material when tested, shall be the limits of tolerances, as applicable over the declared nominal value and given under clause 2.3.1 of the standard.'

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 31 December 1976, after the draft finalized by the Pest Control Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council and the Chemical Division Council. 0.2 Dalapon-sodium salt water soluble powders are used for the control of annual and perennial grasses. It is a selective contact herbicide, translocated from foliage to roots.

0.3 In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to
the provisions of the Insecticides Act, 1968 and the I~lJJ(Os framed thcr e� under. However, this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under these, wherever applicable.

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a fest or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960�. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for dalapon-sodium salt water soluble powders.

2. REQ,UIREMENTS
2.1 The product shall be a homogeneous mixture containing the sodium-salt of 2) 2-dichloropropionic acid as the only active ingredient and shall be in the form of a fine powder or easily friable }UI11pS, free from visible extraneous material. It shall contain onlv water soluble wetting and dispersing agents. "

2.3.1 When determined by the method prescribed in Appendix A of IS : 8267-1976*, the observed dalapon-sodium content in the formulation, percent by mass, of any of the samples shall not differ from 80 by more than +5 or - 3 percent, as allowable tolerance. 2.3.1.1 The actual value or the dalapon-sodium in the formulation shall be calculated to the second decimal place and then rounded off to the first decimal place before applying the tolerance as stipulated in 2.3.1.

3. PACKING AND MARKING

3.1 Packia! - The material shall be packed in clean and dry containers .
made of fibreboard or mild steel with a polyethylene lining of thickness not less than 0�062 mm,

3.1.1 Material up to 500 g shall be packed in polyethylene bag of thickness not less than 0�062 mm, its mouth heet sealed and then packed in a cardboard carton individually (Stl IS : 6604-1972t ). 3.1.2 The containers specified in 3.1 and 3.1.1 shall also comply with general requirements as stipulated in 2 of IS : 8190 (Part I )-1976*.

3.2 Markiag - The containers shall bear legibly and indelibly the following information in addition to the provisions required under the Insecticides Act and Rules: a) Name of the materia), b) Name of the manufacturer, c) Date of manufacture, d) Net mass of contents, e) Dalapon-sodium content, percent mass/mass, f) Batch number, and g) The minimum cautionary notice worded as under:

3.2.1 The container may also be marked with the lSI Certification Mark.
NOTB - The use of the lSI Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution ( Certification ~tarks ) Act and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The lSI Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by lSI and ope-rated by the producer. lSI marked products are also continuously checked by lSI for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the lSI Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.
